notes: No size found. NCRS thread (66573, snippet) says original is a pop (blind) rivet with square mandrel, used as rear compartment reinforcement rivet on 1973 coupe; another poster says AIM drawing looks flat head. NCRS pages 403. Pass 4: Dr. Rebuild sells genuine NOS GM 3828470 as a black-housing pop rivet; JohnZ on CorvetteForum: bonding strips on the birdcage use pop-rivets 3828470 (St. Louis). Dr. Rebuild's 73-79 grille repro set uses aluminum flat-head rivets instead. No diameter or length anywhere.
